case_study_selection_note: Selected after discovery on 15 October 2026 from five candidates (Dresden State Art Collections, Vivaticket shared ticketing platform, British Library recovery, Lee Enterprises, RTV Noord) using recency, sector relevance, EU relevance, causal clarity, disclosed public-access outcome, transferability and evidence quality. Dresden is the only recent EU case with a Tier 1 chronology from the affected institution, its ministry, the prosecutor and the state criminal police. See 01_research_plan.md and report Chapter 5 selection matrix.
